log_level.title: log_level
log_level.description: How much the client logs. Raise it on a device that is misbehaving, lower it when you are done.

health_interval_s.title: health_interval_s
health_interval_s.description: Seconds between the client's own health measurements. 0 stops them.

required_interval_min.title: required_interval_min
required_interval_min.description: Minutes of silence after which Cumulocity calls this device offline. 0 disables the check. Cumulocity only accepts this from the device while it has no availability set, so on a device that already has one, change it in the cloud instead.

remote_access.title: remote_access
remote_access.description: Whether the cloud may open a tunnel to this device. Turning it off refuses every tunnel until it is turned back on.
